newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia noon rubber steady on Tokyo rebound.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia noon rubber steady on Tokyo rebound.

text.p: Malaysian rubber prices were steady at midday, with the market taking its cue from an early rise in Tokyo futures, traders said.
There was no news of sales or inquiries, however, and activity remained thin, said the traders.
"It's just a question of pricing," said a trader. "We're still waiting for the real demand."
At midday, the Malaysian Rubber Exchange and Licensing Board quoted June RSS One buyer at 276 cents ($1.10) a kg, up half cent from Monday's close.
June SMR 20 buyer was unchanged at 259.
Trading houses offered SMR CV at 332 cents, SMR L at 310 cents, SMR 5 at 269, SMR 10 at 255 and drum latex at 226 cents.
